summary: Drawing on the 2025-26 Epstein files, the story traces how convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein used money and connections in the 2010s to push crypto, video game microtransactions, race science, anti-trans research and the online far right.

evidence.note: series framed around the DOJ file releases of 2025 and early 2026

notes: Format: chose deep-dive over current-affairs; it is pegged to new file releases but the bulk is researched history.
